COMMERCIAL TRIBUNAL & BANKRUPTCY COURT OF PARIS // BANQUE DANGLARS LIQUIDATION PROCEEDINGS.

5. Person Edmond Dantes [ID:P522] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-THOMSON-FRENCH].
6. Person Gerard de Villefort [ID:P523] is named as Crown Prosecutor indicted for concealing judicial treason.
7. Person Gerard de Villefort [ID:P523] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-VILLEFORT-PROC].
